name: search-relevance
description: Overhaul search relevance across the catalogue

behavioural-ranking.summary: Close the loop from click and purchase events into the ranker.
behavioural-ranking.description: Click and purchase events land in the events pipeline but nothing feeds them back into ranking. The pipeline is reliable; the work is deciding what signals feed the ranker and how.

synonym-handling.summary: Replace the hand-maintained synonym and misspelling list.
synonym-handling.description: Synonyms and misspellings are handled by a hand-maintained list nobody trusts. The leaning is to replace it rather than clean it, but with what is unknown.

relevance-measurement.summary: How to tell whether a relevance change makes results better or worse.
relevance-measurement.description: There is no evaluation set and no metrics — every ranking tweak is decided by argument. The area the user understands least; they have never built an evaluation harness.

evaluation-harness.question: What does a good evaluation harness look like for this catalogue?

tail-regressions.question: How do search evaluation harnesses handle a change that lifts the aggregate metric while a query slice regresses?

label-freshness.question: How often do click-derived judgments need refreshing before they mislead?

offline-judges.question: Would a small panel of human raters catch a bias the click-derived judgments share?
offline-judges.note: no budget for human raters this year
